title: Blog outline: On Wix, llms.txt follows the builder
why: Insight lab 2026-W48, candidate 1 (medium): llms.txt presence follows the site builder. Wix 32 of 33 homepages, Squarespace 3 of 33, others 591 of 1,187. Six purposive samples, 1,253 homepages, 26 Oct to 28 Nov 2026. Mechanism documented by Wix's help center (updated 9 Sep 2026). Waits for the blog proposal to be approved.
body:
# On Wix, llms.txt follows the builder. What that means for the file and for audits

## The finding
- 1,253 homepages of small and mid-size B2B SaaS, agency and professional-services sites, six independent samples, scanned 26 Oct to 28 Nov 2026.
- llms.txt present: Wix 32 of 33 (97%), Squarespace 3 of 33 (9%), all other platforms 591 of 1,187 (50%).
- Wix minus Squarespace: 88 points, bootstrap 95% interval 76 to 97. Same direction in each of the six samples.
- Both groups are mostly professional-services firms (Wix 27 of 33, Squarespace 24 of 33): not a segment-mix effect.

## The mechanism
- Wix help center, "Understanding your site's llms.txt file" (updated 9 Sep 2026): "Wix automatically generates and maintains your llms.txt file". Editing stops automatic updates; resetting resumes them; there is an opt-out toggle. Prerequisites: upgraded site, custom domain, indexing on.
- The three Wix files read on 28 Nov 2026 follow one template: a heading and a generated summary of the firm.
- Squarespace: third-party guides describe an opt-in setting on 7.1 sites. Not confirmed in Squarespace's own documentation; say so in the post.

## What it means
- For a site owner on Wix: a generator wrote the summary of your firm that sits in that file. Read it.
- For anyone auditing sites: llms.txt presence on its own says more about the builder than the owner's intent. Record the platform first.
- For our own score: the llms.txt check (4 of 100 points) cannot tell a generated file from a written one. Say so plainly.
- What this does not show: whether any AI system reads llms.txt. No demonstrated effect on Google; we do not measure use.

## Monday morning
- Open yourdomain.com/llms.txt. On Wix, correct what is wrong (editing pauses automatic updates). On other builders, decide whether you want one; the /tools llms.txt checker and generator help.

## Related research
- /research/llms-txt-adoption-2026 (64 sites, 29 Jul 2026: Shopify generates the file; llms.txt on 76% of consumer vs 55% of B2B).
- /research/state-of-ai-readiness (219 hand-picked sites, July 2026).

## Run the scan
- Free scan on the homepage, with UTM per channel when published.

## Method note
- Purposive samples found by web search, not random, so likely more SEO-active than average. 33 sites per builder. Platform detected by a pattern in the page source. Homepage, robots.txt and llms.txt read once each from a data-center address; present means a 200 response that is not an HTML page. No site named. Confidence: medium.
